mapper.select: SELECT c.branch_name AS branch_name, c.address AS address FROM T_CinemaFranchise c ORDER BY c.branch_num ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT i.movie_title AS movie_title, s.screening_date AS screening_date, i.running_time AS running_time, i.audience_rating AS audience_rating FROM T_Info i JOIN T_Schedule s ON i.movie_num = s.movie_num JOIN T_Theater t ON s.screening_num = t.screening_num JOIN T_CinemaFranchise c ON t.branch_num = c.branch_num WHERE REPLACE(c.branch_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{branchName}, ' ', ''), '%') AND s.screening_date >= NOW() AND s.screening_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 DAY) ORDER BY s.screening_date ASC

SELECT s.seat_real_num AS seat, s.seat_type AS seatType, CASE WHEN s.seat_code IN ( SELECT seat_number FROM T_ReservationInfo WHERE state = '결제완료' ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS available FROM T_Seat s JOIN T_Schedule sch ON s.schedule_num = sch.schedule_num JOIN T_Info i ON sch.movie_num = i.movie_num JOIN T_Theater t ON sch.screening_num = t.screening_num JOIN T_CinemaFranchise c ON t.branch_num = c.branch_num WHERE REPLACE(c.branch_name, ' ', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{branchName}, ' ', ''), '%') AND i.movie_title = #{movieTitle} ORDER BY s.seat_real_num ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ReservationInfo ( reservation_num, seat_number, customer_name, payment_time, seat_num, state, member_code ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(reservation_num), 2000) + 1 FROM T_ReservationInfo), (SELECT seat_code FROM T_Seat WHERE seat_real_num = #{seat}), #{memberName}, NOW(), (SELECT seat_code FROM T_Seat WHERE seat_real_num = #{seat}), '결제완료', (SELECT member_code FROM T_MemberInfo WHERE member_name = #{memberName}) );
